records.name: Beyond the Bell Tours
records.summary: A paid walking tour company that sells public tours, private group tours and gift certificates for Philadelphia history.
records.notes: Commercial tour operator. The site shows no class, membership, volunteer or community program, so it is treated as a business under the Cultural Fund rule. A Caroline LeCount Fund link appears on the site but was not examined. The site has no dated items.

records.name: Black Spatial Relics
records.summary: An arts project that runs an artist in residence program, small grants for artists, public events and gatherings, and a newsletter.
records.what_you_do: Sign up for the newsletter to hear about open calls, go to public events, or apply to the artist program or grants when a call is open.

first_step.how: Join the newsletter from the sign up link on the site, then check the Upcoming Events page for the next public event
first_step.basis: Events and calls for artists are public, and the newsletter is open to anyone

records.notes: No dated items on the homepage. Convening 2023 and the 2025 Conjure Council Fund appear only as titles, so no month of sign of life is recorded. The city is not stated on the page; Philadelphia comes from the Cultural Fund list. The Upcoming Events, Updates and Team pages were not read. Category and tag are the closest fit from the mission, not a confirmed match.

records.name: Broad Street Review
records.summary: An online arts and culture magazine with essays, reviews, features, profiles and a podcast, plus a free weekly newsletter. Writers can send in work.
records.what_you_do: Read and share its reviews and features, follow its weekly arts roundup, or send a pitch or writing sample that follows its writers guidelines.

first_step.how: Sign up for the free weekly newsletter, or read the writers guidelines before sending a pitch
first_step.basis: The newsletter and writers guidelines are public and the site lists how to pitch

records.notes: Several posts are dated October 7, 2026, including a weekly arts roundup. The site says it receives support from the Philadelphia Cultural Fund. The page does not state its city, so Philadelphia comes from the Cultural Fund list. Whether it holds in-person events was not established.

records.name: Cannonball Festival
records.summary: A nonprofit that puts on a yearly festival of circus and performance art in Philadelphia, with an open call for performing artists.
records.what_you_do: Perform in the festival through the Artist Open Call, see shows and workshops during the festival, or donate or join the mailing list.

first_step.how: Check the Plan Your Visit page or the Philadelphia Fringe lineup for the 2026 shows, or apply through the 2026 Artist Open Call if you perform
first_step.basis: Shows are public and the open call is open to artists

records.notes: The site names the 2026 festival but shows no post dates. Circus has no tag in the vocabulary, so theater and variety were used. The address is the published mailing address. The leadership page was not read.

records.name: Casa de Duende
records.summary: An arts organization that puts on art exhibitions, music, dance, film and spoken word shows, and runs Dos Lenguas Press, which publishes Latin American poets in English and Spanish.
records.what_you_do: Go to exhibitions and performances, read books from Dos Lenguas Press, or join community care projects it organizes or raises money for.

first_step.how: Email the organization at the address on its contact page to ask about upcoming shows and exhibitions
first_step.basis: Events are public, but the site does not explain how to attend or sign up

records.notes: No dated items on the site. Exhibitions of visual art have no exact tag, so painting is left out. David Acosta is listed as artistic director. Phone not listed.

records.name: Casa de Venezuela, Inc.
records.summary: A nonprofit built around Venezuelan culture. Its Miranda Program offers culture and education events, professional workshops and networking, and health information for immigrants and refugees.
records.what_you_do: Go to its education, networking and sports events, take part in its professional workshops, or use its immigration, health and English language resources.

first_step.how: Check the Events page for the next education, networking or sports event
first_step.basis: The site says everyone is welcome and lists its events publicly

records.notes: No dated items on the site. Venezuelan heritage is not in the audience id list, so no heritage tag was set. Scholarship and advocacy work (TPS, VERDAD Act) exists but is not recorded as a service. Board and Contact pages were not read, and no email or phone appears in the page text.

records.name: Centro Nueva Creacion
records.summary: A nonprofit founded in 1995 that supports young people with after school programs, a summer camp, and arts and photography projects rooted in Latino culture.
records.what_you_do: Young people join the after school program or summer camp or take part in the Goodlands photography project. Families can call to ask about enrollment.

cost.text: The site lists a $95 fee for a semester of after school programming. This may be out of date.

first_step.how: Call 215-426-8762 to ask about after school enrollment or summer camp. The site invites visitors to come by Monday to Friday, 7 am to 9 pm.
first_step.basis: The page does not explain how enrollment or registration works

records.notes: The site says it is in Fairhill and uses a 215 phone number, but the city is not stated outright. No dated items on the site. The email address is hidden behind page code and was not recorded. The site's team page was not read.

records.name: Choral Arts Philadelphia
records.summary: A choir that has performed in Philadelphia since 1982, giving a concert season near Rittenhouse Square with holiday programs. It has an audition page for singers.
records.what_you_do: Sing in the choir after an audition, go to concerts, or volunteer or donate through the site's Volunteer and Donate pages.

schedule.text: Concert season October 2026 to May 2027, with holiday programs such as Carols by Candlelight

first_step.how: Read the Auditions page on choralartsphila.org, or buy a ticket for a 2026 to 27 season concert through the Learn More link
first_step.basis: Joining the choir appears to need an audition. The concerts are open to ticket buyers, and the audition page is public.

records.notes: The 2026 to 27 season is the newest item and has no post date. The page text was cut off after about 100000 characters, so later sections were not read. No street address or email was found in the text read. Artistic director and board are not named in the text read.

records.name: Cleaver Magazine
records.summary: An independent online literary magazine, published quarterly since 2013, that also runs writing classes and needs volunteer reviewers, editors and interns.
records.what_you_do: Take a craft or business of writing class, volunteer as a reviewer, editor or intern, or send in writing through its online submissions portal.

cost.text: Free quarterly subscription. Class prices are not in the text read.

first_step.how: Subscribe to the free quarterly issue on the Subscribe page, or sign up for a class through the Classes page
first_step.basis: Classes are offered at every experience level and the site lists how to sign up

records.notes: Newest dated item is a craft essay dated September 30, 2026. Issue 54 (Summer 2026) is listed. The contact email is hidden on the page and was not recorded. Reading series and events are not mentioned.

records.name: CraftNOW Philadelphia
records.summary: An organization that supports the craft community of Philadelphia. It runs CraftMONTH each November, with free hands-on craft activities, a symposium, citywide exhibitions, and education for kids, teens and adults.
records.what_you_do: Take part in the free CraftNOW Create activities or the symposium during CraftMONTH, sign up for the mailing list, or join the education programs for kids, teens or adults.

cost.text: CraftNOW Create activities and the symposium are listed as free

first_step.how: Sign up for the mailing list on the home page, then pick a free CraftMONTH event in November 2026
first_step.basis: Free public events are listed with dates, and the site has a mailing list sign up

records.notes: Dated events for 2026 are listed, including Tools of the Trades 2026, Summer Camp 2026 and the November CraftMONTH, with the symposium on November 12, 2026. The site gives two different dates for the free CraftNOW Create day (November 2 and November 7, 2026), so confirm before publishing. The page has no contact email or phone, only a contact page link. Last dated media upload is January 2026.
